name: Mercy USA for Aid and Development
mission: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is dedicated to alleviating human suffering and supporting individuals and their communities in their efforts to become more self-sufficient. Our philosophy is "Helping People Help Themselves".  Incorporated in the State of Michigan in 1988, Mercy-USA's projects focus on improving health, nutrition and access to safe water, as well as promoting economic and educational growth and providing disaster relief around the world.

strengths_deep_dive: Mercy-USA demonstrates strong operational directness by delivering emergency healthcare and nutrition aid straight to beneficiaries in active crisis zones. Third-party evaluations highlight solid governance, earning a <cite id="1">92.3/100 score from Charity Navigator</cite>. Furthermore, its cash-adjusted program expense ratio of 96.3% beats the 75% industry standard, demonstrating that public contributions are channeled efficiently toward core international programs.
rich_narrative.summary: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development provides critical health and nutrition services to vulnerable families in Somalia, Syria, and other crisis zones. Founded in 1988, the organization has built a long-standing track record in direct relief. In FY2023, the organization brought in <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $54,067,823</cite>. Revenue experienced a recent contraction, dropping to $34,922,507 in FY2024. Despite financial shifts, program efficiency remains solid. The organization maintains a <cite id="1">Cash-adjusted program expense ratio of 96.3%</cite>, which exceeds the 75% industry standard, while its FY2024 filed Program Expense Ratio stands at 96.3%. Third-party evaluations confirm strong operational standards, reflected in a <cite id="1">92.3/100 score from Charity Navigator</cite>. Mercy-USA operates as a <cite id="2">zakat-eligible charity</cite> focusing on primary needs including healthcare, nutrition, clean water access, and emergency response.
